{{Quote|I'm coming, cyborg. It's time.|Mara Jade Skywalker, before facing Lumiya|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>}}
The '''Duel on Hesperidium''' was a vicious [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|fight]] that occurred in the year [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and [[Lumiya]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Having tracked Lumiya through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to the resort [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]], Skywalker engaged her fellow former-[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Hand]] in combat, intent on eliminating the Sith for threats made against Skywalker's son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]].

Both women displayed their finesse with their weapons; Lumiya with her signature [[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip]], and Skywalker with her own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Skywalker quickly gained the advantage, managing to land several critical blows before she executed what she believed to be the killing blow. Lumiya's life was spared, however, when her recently-acquired [[Sith Meditation Sphere|Meditation Sphere]] intervened on her behalf to disable Skywalker. Reeling in surprise at the sudden and unexpected attack, Skywalker was helpless under the strength of Ship's attack, and watched in anger as Lumiya escaped her wrath yet again.

It was only after a conversation with her son Ben did Mara realize she had been jumped by Lumiya's [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], and that the Sith Lady was also secretly in league with Skywalker's nephew [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], leader of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I need your help, I need you to distract Mara for a while.|[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] to Lumiya|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice" />}}
[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and his wife [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], were aware that [[Lumiya]], self-proclaimed [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], was actively spreading her [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] influence throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] once again. Concern had also arisen between them that Lumiya was hunting their son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], and was doing so through an inside connection to the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], the secret police of the Galactic Alliance. They even suspected that Lumiya's influence had spread so far as to enthrall their nephew [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], leader of the GAG.

Lumiya had indeed been in collusion with Solo; however, when Mara questioned Solo about Lumiya's involvement in GAG affairs, he denied any such notion, while secretly becoming concerned that his aunt would soon discover the truth in her assumptions.

Lumiya then devised a plan to draw the Skywalker's attention away from her [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] Solo, by taking a pair of Ben's boots and leaving them outside the Skywalker residence. Luke found them, and immediately deduced that Lumiya had deliberately placed the boots where he would be sure to find them. Because of this, it was decided that Mara should find and confront Lumiya, while Luke himself monitored Jacen's actions. Mara Jade Skywalker immediately set out in search for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] Lumiya, following a trail through the Force that pointed in the direction of [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]], a resort-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]].

She immediately felt Lumiya's dark [[The Force/Legends|Force aura]], and ignited her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as she began searching the surrounding hotel area for her quarry. Instead of finding Lumiya, however, Skywalker encountered the Sith's [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|ship]] as she rounded the corner, one which resembled a large, disembodied eye. Communicating through the Force, the Sith ship beckoned Skywalker to enter; an invitation which she cautiously accepted, fully expecting to find her quarry inside. She entered the empty vessel, had a brief discussion with the Meditation Sphere, and placed a tracking device inside before Lumiya herself finally appeared outside between a few parked ships. The two women silently acknowledged each other, and engaged in intense combat.

==The duel==
{{Quote|Hello little housewife&hellip;|Lumiya to Mara Jade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice" />}}
Skywalker leaped at Lumiya with her lightsaber drawn, managing to slice off a corner of the Sith's headdress. In turn, Lumiya quickly whirled her [[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip]] in Skywalker's direction, but missed her target after being Force-[[Telekinesis/Legends|pushed away]] by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Skywalker evaded as Lumiya lashed her whip again, this time just barely missing Skywalker's head. As Lumiya raised her arm for another strike, Skywalker shot her in the shoulder with her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], hitting one of Lumiya's cybernetics, but with little effect. Skywalker then quickly lunged at Lumiya's [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] legs, the impact of which filled her mouth with blood, while at the same time toppling Lumiya. She then head-butted her [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] jaw causing more pain to herself. In a surprise tactic, Mara turned off her lightsaber, only to reignite it in Lumiya's chest. Ship then intervened, and Mara felt a metal coil wrap around her neck and throw her backwards. Mara hit the ground, looking up in time to see Lumiya's boots fly past her face. She then looked up to see the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] fly away, with Lumiya safely inside.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Sorry I'm late, ran into a few problems.|Mara Jade Skywalker to the Jedi Council|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice" />}}
As the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] were discussing what action should be taken about the recent [[Solo-Niathal coup|coup]] and the Mandalorian alliance with the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]], Mara entered the chamber still bearing her gruesome battle wounds. After assuring everyone she was fine, she informed them of Lumiya's new ship and that she would be ready for the next time she fought the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]].

Ben Skywalker later learned from the Ship that it intervened because its purpose was to train [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] to fight. It would let the two fight but not let either one be killed. However, both combatants died not long after the duel. Soon after, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] [[Skirmish on Kavan|killed]] Mara on [[Kavan]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Duel on Terephon|killed]] Lumiya on [[Terephon]].
